parts.reason: S5.1 explicitly excludes calculation of correlation coefficients using the formula; here the mark scheme requires computing r via Sxp/√(Sxx·Syy), which is the excluded formula method.

parts.reason: This part depends on the values of q and r obtained in part (c), which is out of spec (variance calculation excluded); since it only makes sense after an out-of-spec part, it is also out.
